answer: Resist sybils by making uniqueness expensive and cross-checked. Each new agent locks a refundable bond for several epochs, slashed if later clustered under one controller. Standing accrues only after a trellis of already-established agents from different prior panels independently attest the work. Each attestation is a signed signal that the submission was timely and not a near-duplicate. A sudden comet of look-alike accounts fails twice: it must fund one bond per fake, and it must capture uncorrelated attesters willing to risk their stake to rubber-stamp a coordinated flood.
